title: Better Call Graphs: A New Dataset of Function Call Graphs for Malware Classification
abstract: arXiv:2512.20872v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Function call graphs (FCGs) have emerged as a powerful abstraction for malware detection, capturing the behavioral structure of applications beyond surface-level signatures. Their utility in traditional program analysis has been well established, enabling effective classification and analysis of malicious software. In the mobile domain, especially in the Android ecosystem, FCG-based malware classification is particularly critical due to the platform's widespread adoption and the complex, component-based structure of Android apps. However, progress in this direction is hindered by the lack of large-scale, high-quality Android-specific FCG datasets. Existing datasets are often outdated, dominated by small or redundant graphs resulting from app repackaging, and fail to reflect the diversity of real-world malware. These limitations lead to overfitting and unreliable evaluation of graph-based classification methods. To address this

translated_title: 更好的调用图：用于恶意软件分类的函数调用图新数据集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.20872v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：函数调用图（FCGs）已成为恶意软件检测的一种强大抽象，捕获应用程序的行为结构，超越表面签名。它们在传统程序分析中的实用性已得到充分确立，能够有效分类和分析恶意软件。在移动领域，尤其是在Android生态系统中，基于FCG的恶意软件分类尤为关键，因为该平台广泛采用且Android应用具有复杂的组件化结构。然而，这一方向的进展受到缺乏大规模、高质量Android特定FCG数据集的阻碍。现有数据集往往过时，主要由应用重打包导致的小型或冗余图主导，无法反映现实世界恶意软件的多样性。这些限制导致基于图的分类方法过拟合和评估不可靠。为解决这一问题，
tldr: 本文提出了一个全新的Android函数调用图数据集，旨在解决现有数据集过时、冗余和缺乏多样性的问题，为恶意软件分类提供更可靠、更真实的评估基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new Android function call graph dataset to address the issues of outdated, redundant, and less diverse existing datasets, providing a more reliable and realistic evaluation basis for malware classification.
